Clank!, the iconic deck-building board game adventure, challenges daring thieves to sneak into a dragon’s lair, steal one of her precious artifacts, and escape – before you’re roasted to a crisp! entry.title: Ark Nova
entry.content:
Discount Information（Price：$10.99 → $7.99 [$7.99 ~ $10.99]）

All Price Information

Price：$7.99

Application Description

Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game. In Ark Nova, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically managed zoo. With the ultimate goal of owning the most successful zoological establishment, you will build enclosures, accommodate animals, and support conservation projects all over the world. Specialists and unique buildings will help you in achieving this goal. At the heart of Ark Nova are 255 cards featuring animals, specialists, unique enclosures, and conservation projects, each with a particular ability. Use them to increase the appeal and scientific reputation of your zoo and to collect conservation points. Each player has a set of action cards, which you will use and upgrade to carry out your plans. Each player has a set of five action cards to manage their gameplay, and the power of an action is determined by the slot the card currently occupies. The cards are: BUILD: Allows you to build standard or special enclosures, kiosks, and pavilions. ANIMALS: Allows you to accommodate animals in your zoo. CARDS: Allows you to gain new zoo cards (animals, sponsors, and conservation project cards). ASSOCIATION: Allows your association workers to carry out different tasks. SPONSORS: Allows you to play a sponsor card in your zoo or to raise money. With high replayability and rich components, Ark Nova provides a remarkable gaming experience that will bring the game to the table again and again.

Application Description

Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness. The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods. Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright. The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

Application Description

Experience the next generation of professional IPTV playback. Enjoy Live TV, Movies, and Series with advanced playback controls, intelligent organization, and a seamless, reliable streaming experience. “Displays and translates live broadcast speech as subtitles in real time. With Sport API support, you can follow live sports scores and events from around the world instantly. AI-powered Live TV, Movies, and Series features let you search intelligently — just type your favorite actor or artist’s name, and if the movie or series exists in your playlist, it will appear instantly. Plus many more AI-powered features. Notice: To use Normal AI and Sports Data AI features, you must add your own AI API key and active subscription.” Start watching on one device and continue on another without missing anything. Your favorites, settings, and viewing progress sync seamlessly across iOS, iPad, and macOS. Designed for performance and flexibility, this IPTV Smart Player gives you complete control over how you watch, manage, and personalize your content – ​​all in one powerful app. Watch high-quality Live TV, Movies, and Series with EPG, Replay, viewing progress tracking, time-shifted playback, and multilingual UI support. Scheduled Recording for Live TV – schedule recordings in advance by selecting a start date/time (and an optional end time). Select Broadcast or Screen Recording and manage/cancel your scheduled recording anytime from the Live TV player. Organize your content with custom categories, encrypt, rename channels, manage your favorites, and pick up where you left off. Key Features: - Multi-Language Support (48 Languages) - Full optimization for iPhone DUO - Free AI-powered live translation for live streams in all supported languages. - Play on TV (DLNA/UPnP, Air Play, Chromecast) - App management with Siri - Automatic synchronization between devices (IPHONE ↔ IPAD ↔ macOS) - Live stream rewind (10s/30s) **Time Machine - Live TV, Movie and Series Playback - AI-powered live subtitles - Live TV, Movie and Series Playback - Real-time translation Live TV AI - Track Viewing Progress (Continue Watching) - Continue Watching iCloud sync (Backup) - Scheduled Live TV Recording - External subtitle support via OpenSubtitles (OpenSubtitles account required) - Save your movies or series to your local drive. - Record your live streams locally. - PIP Feature (Live TV, Movies, Series) - Creating custom collections - Connection Health Monitoring - System Monitoring - Adding/Removing Channels from Collections - Changing Channel or Category Name - Connection Checker (M3U/Xtream connection test) - Time-shifted playback (forward and backward) - Multilingual interface - 4K playback support* - Broadcast capture and EPG support - Multi-screen viewing - Favorites and custom collections - Category and channel management - Drag and drop sorting - PIN protected Parental Control - Xtream API login support - M3U playlists and URLs - Multiple account support - External player support (VLC) - Advanced filtering and search - Modern, responsive user interface - Ad-free experience And much more Important Notice: This application does not provide any media content. To watch content, you need to add your own IPTV playlist or a subscription from a third-party provider. The screenshots shown are for illustrative purposes only and do not represent actual content. Smart IPTV Player is not affiliated with any third-party provider. You won’t have access to all the graphic settings and may experience some freezes or crashes: iPhone Xr, iPhone SE Gen 2 (2020), iPad Mini Gen 5, iPad Air Gen 3, iPad Gen 8, iPad Gen 9. Slime Rancher is the tale of Beatrix LeBeau, a plucky young rancher who sets out for a life a thousand light years away from Earth on the ‘Far, Far Range,’ where she tries her hand at making a living wrangling slimes. [Explore a vibrant alien world, capture and tend to adorable slimes, and get a once-abandoned ranch back on track!] *** FEATURES *** - Play as a curious and adventurous woman trying to get her newly acquired slime ranch back on track. - Use your trusty vacpack to collect adorable slimes in the wild. Each type has its own likes, dislikes, and sometimes even special needs that must be met to take care of them properly! - Discover new hybrid species! - Explore the vast, colorful nature of the Far, Far Range. Find slimes and gather resources! - Roam around the sands of the Dry Reef, discover the wild flora of the Moss Blanket, and wonder at the shining crystals of the Indigo Quarry while uncovering hidden treasures! - Earn money through daily requests or the market exchange to expand your ranch: decorate your estate, contain your slimes with corrals, grow crops and build coops to feed them. - Earn money through daily requests on the Range Exchange or selling plorts on the Plort Market. Then decorate your ranch house, expand the corrals for your slimes, and feed them by growing gardens and building coops! - Craft and upgrade your vacpack and tools for faster and better ranching! - Follow Bea’s journey at your own pace with 3 different game modes! Adventure Mode lets you experience the trials and tribulations of ranching life as it really is. But you can also play Casual Mode for a cozier experience, or challenge yourself to succeed faster with Rush Mode! CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE - Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control - Game Center achievements - Cloud Saves – share your progress between iOS devices. - Compatible only with PS4, PS5, and Xbox controllers - iPhone 17 Optimization (including Pro Max)
